description: Version 3 of the SAME resource: egfr-456 later retracted with status=entered-in-error. The value is unchanged from version 2, because a retraction invalidates the record rather than restating the result. Distinct from egfr-entered-in-error, which is a separate resource (egfr-456-eie) and therefore cannot exercise removal of a previous version's derived assertions.

lineage.note: Supersedes version 2 (fixtures/r4/egfr/egfr-corrected). Concept note section 2: suppresses clinical assertions from that resource but does not erase the source record, so version 2's derived assertions must go while all three versions stay auditable.
